content.en: The **New Industrial Policy (1991)** marked a watershed moment for the Indian economy. It focused on **de-licensing**, reducing the number of industries reserved for the public sector, and encouraging **Foreign Direct Investment (FDI)**. These reforms aimed to dismantle the restrictive regulatory environment that hindered industrial expansion.
